# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/subscriptions/check

Check if the authenticated user is subscribed to an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-220`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — WatchInfo

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `subscribed` | bool | Whether user is watching the issue |
| `ignored` | bool | Inverse of subscribed |
| `reason` | any | Always nil |
| `created_at` | time.Time | Issue creation time |
| `url` | string | Subscriptions API URL |
| `repository_url` | string | Repository API URL |
